title: Circumvent
summary: CIRCUMVENT, verb transitive Literally, to come round; hence, To gain advantage over another, or to accomplish a purpose, by arts, stratagem, or deception; to deceive; to prevail over another by wiles

inlines.v: CIRCUMVENT, verb transitive Literally, to come round; hence, To gain advantage over another, or to accomplish a purpose, by arts, stratagem, or deception; to deceive; to prevail over another by wiles or fraud; to delude; to impose on.
